style: Visual style: inspired by Lovable and Meta Muse - warm, airy, friendly and premium. Off-white canvas (#FBF8F4) with a soft blurred gradient glow (peach, coral, lavender) behind key areas, frosted translucent panels, large rounded corners (16-24px), generous whitespace, very subtle shadows, hairline borders, modern geometric sans-serif typography, crisp and legible text. Primary accent coral-orange #FF6B4A, secondary lavender #8B7CF6, success mint green. The app is called "Muster". Mascot characters appear as small avatars: cute round pebble-shaped creatures with a tiny sprout antenna and two shiny bead eyes, flat vector with soft shading. Main bot "Pip" is cream-colored; sub-bots each have a different pastel color and slightly different pebble shape: "小码" mint green rounded-square pebble, "阿克" peach blob pebble, "小探" sky-blue egg pebble. Their facial expressions reflect state (thinking, working, waiting, done). UI labels are in Simplified Chinese, short and correctly rendered. No real company logos. A clean flat UI screenshot, straight-on, not a photo of a device, high fidelity, Dribbble-quality product design.

screens.01-home: High-fidelity desktop application UI mockup (16:10) of the HOME screen "主线" of a personal AI agent command center. Layout: (1) Narrow left sidebar: app wordmark "Muster", vertical nav with icons and labels 主线, 团队, 事件, 设备, 技能, 设置; below it a short list of recent threads. (2) Center: a conversation with the main bot Pip (cream pebble avatar beside its messages). The user message bubble says "shop-api 里两件事：修支付回调 bug 交给小码，写退款接口交给阿克". Pip replies briefly and shows two elegant dispatch cards side by side, each with a sub-bot avatar (mint 小码 with small grey text "Codex", peach 阿克 with small grey text "Claude"), task title, a progress bar and status chip "工作中". Below, inline choice chips "顺便跑测试" "完成后通知我". Bottom: a large rounded composer with placeholder "和 Pip 说点什么…", a hint "Enter 插话 · Alt+Enter 排队", attach and voice icons, coral send button. (3) Right frosted panel with stacked sections: "进行中" (3 tasks with tiny avatars and states), "需要你" (an approval card: "小码 想运行 pnpm install" with buttons 允许 and 拒绝), "日程" (每日 09:00 晨间简报), "已连接电脑" (MacBook Pro 本机 and 书房台式机 with green online dots).
screens.02-workbench: High-fidelity desktop application UI mockup (16:10) of the SUB-BOT WORKBENCH screen of a personal AI agent app. Top bar: breadcrumb "主线 › 修支付回调", the sub-bot identity: mint green pebble avatar with focused working expression, name "小码", small grey source text "Codex", status pill "工作中", git branch chip "muster/fix-callback". Center column: the agent conversation; tool activity folded into compact summary rows like "读取了 6 个文件 · 运行了 2 条命令" with expand chevrons; one user steer bubble highlighted in lavender labelled "插话 · 下一步生效" saying "回调要兼容旧签名"; hovering a step shows a small floating action "从这里分支" with a fork icon. Bottom composer: placeholder "给小码插话…", buttons "排队" and "打断" and a coral send. Right side panel with tabs "改动", "终端", "日志": shows a clean code diff with green and red lines in a monospace font, file name payment/callback.ts, and a test summary "12 通过 · 0 失败".
screens.03-branches: High-fidelity desktop application UI mockup (16:10) of the BRANCH TIMELINE screen "分支" of a personal AI agent app. Upper half: a beautiful horizontal timeline tree on a soft gradient canvas: a main path of rounded turn nodes (numbered steps with tiny icons) and two branches forking from step 5, each branch drawn as a smooth curved line in different pastel colors, with small pebble mascot avatars sitting at the branch heads (mint 小码 on one, peach 阿克 on the other). Labels "原始路线", "分支 A：队列重试", "分支 B：幂等键方案". Lower half: side-by-side comparison cards of branch A and B showing summary, files changed count, test results (green check "全部通过" vs amber "2 个失败"), token cost, and buttons "采用此分支" (coral) and "继续这个分支". Calm, elegant, data-rich but airy.
screens.04-events: High-fidelity desktop application UI mockup (16:10) of the EVENT CENTER screen "事件" of a personal AI agent app where everything is an event. Left/center: a vertical event stream timeline with colored source icons and pastel chips: "GitHub · PR #128 已打开 · shop-api" then "观察模式：已记录将会做什么"; "定时 · 每日 09:00 晨间简报 · 已送达"; "回调 · 小码 完成了 修支付回调"; "设备 · 书房台式机 上线"; "你 · 插话 给 阿克". Filter chips at top: 全部, 用户, 定时, GitHub, 回调, 设备. Right panel: a trigger rule editor card titled "当 PR 打开时" with readable form rows: 来源 GitHub shop-api; 交给 阿克 (peach pebble avatar); 模式 segmented control "观察 / 询问 / 自动" with 询问 selected; 每日预算 slider; toggle "无人值守时自动拒绝审批". Below it a list of existing triggers with on/off toggles.
screens.05-crew: High-fidelity desktop application UI mockup (16:10) of the TEAM screen "团队" of a personal AI agent app. A friendly grid of large rounded member cards, each with a big cute pebble mascot avatar (flat vector, soft shading, sprout antenna, bead eyes) in a different pastel color and shape: Pip (cream, main bot, label 主 Bot · 只做分发), 小码 (mint, small grey text Codex, status 工作中), 阿克 (peach, small grey text Claude, status 等你审批 with a little raised hand), 小探 (sky blue, 内置研究员, status 空闲 sleepy face), 小文 (lilac, 内置办公助手, status 已完成 happy face). Each card shows status pill, this-week cost, skill tags, and a "聊天" button. Last card is a dashed "添加成员" card listing auto-detected local agents with checkmarks: claude 已检测, codex 已检测, opencode 已检测. Delightful, playful but premium.
screens.06-devices: High-fidelity desktop application UI mockup (16:10) of the DEVICES and REMOTE BROWSER screen "设备" of a personal AI agent app. Left column: device list cards with OS icons and green/grey dots: "MacBook Pro · 本机", "书房台式机 · Ubuntu · 在线", "云服务器 · 离线"; a pairing card showing a 6-digit code "482 913" and a short emoji fingerprint row for verification, button "配对新电脑". Main area: a large remote browser viewport framed like a rounded window with an address bar, showing a web form page being filled; a soft glowing agent cursor with a sky-blue pebble avatar badge and caption bubble "小探 正在填写报销表单 · 第 3/5 步". Under the viewport: control buttons "接管", "暂停", "结束", and a live step list beside the viewport with checkmarks. Elegant frosted glass panels on warm off-white.
screens.07-mobile: High-fidelity mobile app UI mockup: three phone screens shown side by side flat (no device photo, just rounded screen frames) on a warm peach-lavender gradient background, for a personal AI agent app "Muster". Screen 1 "主线": greeting with cream pebble mascot Pip, a compact feed of task cards with tiny pastel pebble avatars and progress. Screen 2 approval: a large clear approval card "阿克 想发布 PR 审查评论" with risk tag "中风险", a short preview of the comment, big buttons "允许" (coral) and "拒绝", and a checkbox "总是允许此类操作". Screen 3: chat with sub-bot 小码 (mint pebble), a lavender steer bubble "先别动数据库迁移", and a composer. Simplified Chinese labels, clean, friendly, premium.
screens.08-mascots: Character design sheet for an app mascot family, flat vector illustration with soft gradient shading, on a clean warm off-white background with subtle grid and labels in Simplified Chinese. Five cute round pebble-shaped creatures, each with a tiny sprout antenna and two shiny bead eyes, minimal and iconic, original design (not robots from any existing brand): 1) Pip cream color (main bot), 2) 小码 mint green rounded-square pebble, 3) 阿克 peach blob, 4) 小探 sky-blue egg shape, 5) 小文 lilac flat pebble. For Pip, show a row of 7 state expressions with labels: 空闲, 思考, 工作中, 等你审批 (raising a little hand), 已完成 (happy sparkle), 出错 (dizzy), 睡眠. Also small app-icon versions. Cohesive, delightful, professional brand IP sheet.
